ex.en: The aggregate cost of the project was over budget.
ex.zh: 專案的總成本超出預算。

ex.en: Aggregate demand fell during the recession.
ex.zh: 經濟衰退期間，總需求下降了。

ex.en: The app aggregates news from many sources.
ex.zh: 這個 App 匯集了許多來源的新聞。

ex.en: We aggregated the data from all branches.
ex.zh: 我們彙整了所有分公司的資料。

ex.en: In aggregate, sales rose by ten percent.
ex.zh: 整體來看，銷售額成長了一成。

ex.en: Taken in aggregate, the results are encouraging.
ex.zh: 整體來看，結果令人振奮。

ex.en: The government should invest more money in agriculture.
ex.zh: 政府應該增加對農業的投資。

ex.en: Agriculture consumes a great amount of water.
ex.zh: 農業需要消耗大量的水。

ex.en: This land is not suitable for agriculture.
ex.zh: 這塊地不適合務農。

ex.en: In my view you should try the exam again.
ex.zh: 我認為你應該再考一次。

ex.en: Our teacher warned him not to be late again.
ex.zh: 老師警告他不要再遲到。

ex.en: There is little chance of my meeting him again.
ex.zh: 我大概不會再見到他了。

ex.en: When I was your age, Pluto was a planet.
ex.zh: 我在你這個年紀時，冥王星還是行星。

ex.en: The difference in their ages is six years.
ex.zh: 他們相差六歲。

ex.en: Because of his age, my grandfather doesn't hear well.
ex.zh: 因為年紀大了，我祖父聽力不太好。

ex.en: My father aged a lot since last year.
ex.zh: 我爸從去年到現在老了很多。

ex.en: An aging population will require more spending on health care.
ex.zh: 人口老化將需要更多醫療保健支出。

ex.en: We live in the digital age.
ex.zh: 我們生活在數位時代。

ex.en: The internet age has changed how we work.
ex.zh: 網路時代改變了我們的工作方式。

ex.en: You should have told me a long time ago.
ex.zh: 你早就該告訴我了。

ex.en: She finished ironing the clothes a few minutes ago.
ex.zh: 她幾分鐘前燙完了衣服。

ex.en: Prices are double what they were ten years ago.
ex.zh: 物價是十年前的兩倍。

agency.zh: 代理商、仲介公司（travel agency 旅行社）

ex.en: Travel agencies' profits soared.
ex.zh: 旅行社的利潤大幅成長。

ex.en: He works for an advertising agency.
ex.zh: 他在一家廣告公司工作。

ex.en: The car rental agency provided excellent customer service.
ex.zh: 這家租車公司提供了很棒的客戶服務。

ex.en: The government agency approved the new drug.
ex.zh: 政府機構核准了這種新藥。

ex.en: She works for an environmental agency.
ex.zh: 她在一個環保機構工作。

ex.en: Get in touch with your agent right away.
ex.zh: 立刻聯絡你的經紀人。

ex.en: I'm not signing anything until I speak with my agent.
ex.zh: 在跟我的經紀人談過之前，我什麼都不會簽。

ex.en: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
ex.zh: 萬一有緊急情況，請聯絡我的代理人。

agent.zh: 服務人員、業務員（travel agent 旅行社人員）

ex.en: A travel agent will arrange an excursion to Andalusia for you.
ex.zh: 旅行社人員會幫你安排去安達魯西亞的旅遊。

ex.en: Sami was a customer service agent.
ex.zh: 薩米是一名客服人員。

ex.en: Portugal was once an agricultural country.
ex.zh: 葡萄牙曾經是一個農業國家。

ex.en: On the border, there is a stretch of agricultural land.
ex.zh: 邊境上有一片農地。

ex.en: Agricultural products are a major export of the country.
ex.zh: 農產品是這個國家主要的出口品。

ex.en: He is an aggressive person.
ex.zh: 他是個咄咄逼人的人。

ex.en: The dog becomes aggressive when strangers come close.
ex.zh: 陌生人靠近時，這隻狗會變得很兇。

ex.en: You need to be aggressive.
ex.zh: 你需要更積極一點。

ex.en: The company has an aggressive marketing strategy.
ex.zh: 這家公司的行銷策略非常積極。

ex.en: He agrees with my opinion.
ex.zh: 他同意我的意見。

ex.en: I agree with what you say to some extent.
ex.zh: 在某種程度上，我認同你所說的。

ex.en: Oh, I don't know if I agree with you.
ex.zh: 嗯，我不確定我同不同意你的看法。

ex.en: Thank you for agreeing to meet with us.
ex.zh: 謝謝你答應跟我們見面。

ex.en: We agreed to start early the next morning.
ex.zh: 我們說好隔天一早出發。

ex.en: I'm surprised you agreed to have lunch with me.
ex.zh: 我很意外你願意跟我吃午餐。

ex.en: They still attacked us, despite clearly agreeing to sign the non-aggression pact.
ex.zh: 明明簽訂了互不侵犯條約，竟然還來攻擊我們。

ex.en: As North Korea displays aggression, South Korea concentrates its forces near the border.
ex.zh: 韓國隨著朝鮮的外患而在邊界附近集結軍隊。

ex.en: Some dogs show aggression toward strangers.
ex.zh: 有些狗對陌生人表現出攻擊性。

ex.en: The coach told the players to channel their aggression into the game.
ex.zh: 教練要球員把他們的攻擊性轉化到比賽中。

ex.en: He cried out in agony when the doctor touched his leg.
ex.zh: 醫生一碰到他的腿，他就痛得大叫。

ex.en: The family waited in agony for news of the missing boy.
ex.zh: 全家人痛苦地等待著失蹤男孩的消息。

ex.en: We have reached a partnership agreement.
ex.zh: 我們簽訂了合作協議。

ex.en: There needs to be agreement between European countries.
ex.zh: 歐洲各國之間需要達成協議。

ex.en: We have to come to some agreement.
ex.zh: 我們必須達成某種協議。

ex.en: I'm not in agreement with your methods at all.
ex.zh: 我完全不贊同你的做法。

ex.en: There is not one person who is in agreement with the plan.
ex.zh: 沒有一個人贊成這個計畫。

ex.en: Let's proceed with the items on the agenda.
ex.zh: 我們繼續討論議程上的項目吧。

ex.en: What's on the agenda for today's meeting?
ex.zh: 今天會議的議程有哪些？
